start_daemon.description: Whether to start the minissdpd daemon (must be set to true in /etc/default/minissdpd for startup to proceed).

interface_address.description: Space-separated list of interface names or IP addresses for SSDP listening (e.g., 'eth0 192.168.1.1'). Required field; must be non-empty.

extra_options.description: Additional command-line options passed to minissdpd (e.g., '-p 1900' or '-d').

pidfile.description: Path to the PID file used by the init script for process management.
